title: Ragni Haryana's native artist heard Poonam Pandit, Toll Taxes

asr.full_text: Ruka Majanvelaji, be happy with an open heart! Beat the Bhimali, who is there? Who are you? Nalitha sister, open this door We are here for Purnam Pandit. My sister is from Yolp and she will be performed for her, the complete sister. My sister has come from the UP so I welcome you from Punap as well. Long live India…. ...female power…. ...long live India. Long live India. ...so thank you all for listening to me. I'm pleased to say that today I'm with my family, my relatives and friends. And, there was one more good thing that happened to me. ...very good. ...it's a great thing. In a simple way, the protestors are just running towards this place . Pandit, you are boosting this peasant movement. May be someone is boosting another group. Shall I call him in TV? So please be with our district Bewani just listen to us what a beautiful state of Vivaani is now, after 2 minutes we will finish and you cannot go back to Bewani, once again you can go to Gurgaon we have a small small shop here in the village called Naraish Shoran the noise is very loud. We pray to God, to make it short. See, my sister Sudhaishi and Poonam Pandey ji are among us. I want to say one thing to you. That sister is a symbol of Rajasthan. She says, leave all the Aryans, Rajasthan, Punjab, UP farmers, all of them will come to Delhi. And what will we do now? Listen my son, what do we do now? Listen my son, what do we do now? All of us together will come to Delhi Forget her
